Description: Names the slide's scan in the photos folder — 1 resolves to photos/1.jpg. Typed Filename so a row whose scan is missing is reported instead of quietly showing no image.
Surname, Given. Prefer an LCNAF or VIAF form; set this column's authority to check it.
The photographer's own caption. Transcribe it as written rather than correcting it.
Physical description of what was scanned, e.g. 35 mm color slide.
The named collection this item belongs to.
